decisions.reason: As a core bread product with visible presentation and no reported disappointment, management would continue it because it fits the established bakery range and there is little pressure to undo the earlier launch.
Because the premium raisin stollen is a publicly emphasized flagship with award recognition, sunk commitment and reputational justification make withdrawal highly unlikely.

Management would still tend to retain this rye variant since it builds on existing capabilities and prior launch commitment, though its more specialized position and overlap with other breads leave some chance of later range rationalization.
